paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss over training time in seconds for two models, Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents training time in seconds, with a linear scale, a value range of 0 to 250000, and tick labels at regular intervals of 50000. The y-axis represents loss, with a linear scale, a value range of 2.40 to 2.75, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot contains two lines: one purple line with triangular markers and a solid line style, representing the Vanilla model, and one red line with circular markers and a solid line style, representing the SepLLM model. The purple line starts at approximately 2.72 and decreases to approximately 2.48 over the training time, with a steady decline. The red line starts at approximately 2.71 and decreases to approximately 2.46 over the training time, also with a steady decline.
